thread:
alex: heads up — we rolled kernel 6.1-rt to the eu-west2 p4 pool at 03:20 for the low-latency patch. seeing multiple hosts fail to load the nvidia module, kernels tainting, and some pods getting OOMs. reverting is in progress but want to capture impact and next steps.
kevin: dropping sample dmesg from one of the affected nodes:
```
[    5.432100] nvidia: disagrees about version of symbol module_layout
[    5.432105] nvidia: Unknown symbol nvidia_pci_probe (err -22)
[    5.432110] nvidia: module tainted: vendor preset
[    5.432115] audit: type=1400 audit(1610000000.432:2): apparmor="DENIED" ...
```
kevin: also saw NCCL handshake timeouts from training jobs shortly after: "NCCL WARN TCP : connect error" on rank 0/3
priya: how many hosts affected and which ASGs? can we isolate to a specific AMI? @alex
alex: ~12/120 p4 instances across two ASGs in eu-west2. the canary AMI had the rt kernel installed via the new image builder pipeline. non-rt 6.x nodes didn't show this. we're reverting the image rollout now.
jasmin: is this a DKMS build failure? often kernel-rt has slightly different ABI for module layout when CONFIG_PREEMPT_RT is set; modules need to be rebuilt against that exact kernel-headers
sam: I inspected the image — the nvidia driver package uses prebuilt modules in /lib/modules for 6.1 but no dkms hooks. so when rt kernel packages were installed, headers weren't present and modules didn't match. short-term we should either include kernel-headers or switch to dkms driver in image.
priya: can we hotfix by forcing driver to recompile on boot? that will disrupt warmup, but might avoid rollback if quick.
alex: trying a quick test repro on a spare node with headers installed.
deploy-bot: rollback triggered by alex at 03:28 — reverting eu-west2 canary AMI -> previous stable (5.15-derived) image. CI: #build-4882
kevin: note — some nodes reported GPU memory allocation failures too (cudaMalloc failed) which caused pods to restart. logs show "CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY" after module mismatch.
sam: long-term action items:
- update image-builder to either ship dkms for nvidia or include matching kernel-headers for every kernel variant we publish
- add a preflight that boots a node and runs `modinfo nvidia` + simple cuda sample
- document known incompatibilities with rt kernels in infra-runbook
priya: also add a canary gating step: don't autoscale new kernel images into production ASGs until canary passes nvidia smoke tests.
alex: agreed. I'll follow up with a postmortem once rollback completes and we gather per-host logs. thanks for the rapid responses :thumbsup:
jasmin: fyi, ap-south and us-central pools show no failures so far — looks regional (image pipeline) not universal.
kevin: adding grep-able snippet for ops alerts:
```
if dmesg | grep -E 'disagrees about version of symbol|Unknown symbol nvidia' ; then
echo "nvidia-mod-load-failure" && trigger-alert
fi
```
alex: good call, adding that to the oncall snippets. closing the canary and blocking further rt image publishes until we have dkms or headers in images.
